name: Smarter Microelectronics (Guangzhou) Co., Ltd.
summary: Smarter Microelectronics (Guangzhou) Co., Ltd., a chip design company, engages in the research, design, development, and sale of radio frequency (RF) front-end chips and modules in China and internationally. The company offers low noise amplifier-power amplifier module integrated filters (L-PAMiF), an integrated RF front-end transceiver module chip integrated with low-noise amplifiers (LNA), PAs, filters, and RF switches; low noise amplifier  front end modules (L-FEM), an integrated RF front-end receiver module chip integrated with LNAs, filters, and RF switches; power amplifier module integrated duplexers (PAMiD)/low noise amplifier  power amplifier module integrated duplexers (L-PAMiD), …
